create_depth_estimation_pipeline: create a DepthEstimationPipeline with a model and optional processor for depth estimation
run_depth_estimation_pipeline: run the depth-estimation pipeline on image file paths, URLs, and PIL images to get predicted depth tensors and depth images
test_large_model_depth_estimation: test the depth-estimation pipeline with the Intel/dpt-large model on a COCO image URL
test_multiprocess_depth_estimation: test the depth-estimation pipeline with num_workers for multi-process inference on multiple images
test_pipeline_output_types: test the depth-estimation pipeline with file paths, URLs, RGBA, LA, and L mode images and verify output structure
